ValidationRule.description: Allow user to decrease the Contract Payment Amount when the Proposal status is "Acceptance Required - Customer"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Corporate_Contract_Payments', ISPICKVAL(Proposal__r.Status__c,'Acceptance Required - Customer'), Amount__c > Payment_Amount__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't increase the Amount when the Proposal status is 'Acceptance Required - Customer'
